title: Fitting Single Effect Regression Models — single_effect_regression
text: single effect regression (SER) model Bayesian   multiple regression model single candidate   variable active (“included”). Therefore,   posterior distribution becomes “mixture” simpler   single-variable regression models. first element SER model multiple regression   model outcome y,   $$y = Xb + e,$$   \(e\) vector independent, normally   distributed error terms, \(e \sim N(0, \sigma^2 )\).   residual variance \(\sigma^2\) assumed known. second element SER model SER prior   coefficients vector \(b\). SER prior   property \(b\) drawn prior exactly   one nonzero coefficient. example, SER model initialized   init_ser_model_normal() defines prior   coefficient \(j\) nonzero prior probability   \(\pi_j\), nonzero coefficient assigned normal   prior zero mean variance \(\sigma_0^2\) may   estimated. SER posterior reduces mixture   single-variable regression models, sufficient statistics   needed compute posterior sufficient   statistics needed compute posterior   single-variable model, least-squares estimate   coefficient variance. key steps analysis single effect regression :   () prepare data using prepare_ser_data function;   (ii) initialize SER model using init_ser_data   function; (iii) fit model compute posterior   statistics fitted model using fit_ser_data   function. Design single effect regression classes.   “single effect regression” (SER) class minimum   following three elements: function initializes SER model (e.g.,     init_ser_model_normal). returns ‘ser’     model. ‘fit_ser_model’ method takes (least) two     inputs, ‘ser’ model ‘ser_data’ data     set. returns updated SER model (object class     ‘ser’). ‘variable.names’ method returns     variable names. control argument list named components override default model fitting settings, typically defined separate function. example, ‘ser_normal’ family default settings defined ser_normal_control_default(). exact model-fitting options different SER family, may include: estimate_prior_variance   estimate_prior_variance = TRUE, prior variance   parameter estimated. global_prior_variance   global_prior_variance = TRUE, prior variance parameters   shared SERs setting also   TRUE. trace trace = TRUE, progress model   fitting recorded returned. verbose verbose = TRUE, progress model   fitting outputted console. version implementation model fitting algorithm   use. “R” “Rcpp”. paramtol NA, stop model   fitting change prior variance parameter two   successive iterations less value. lbftol NA, stop model   fitting change log-Bayes factor two success   iterations less value. maxiter Terminate model fitting reaching   many iterations.
